subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

narrative.audience: Executive seller audience (non-technical stakeholder); no repository mechanics are required for this narrative.
narrative.headline: XaaS v26.10.1 Chicago ecosystem demo: one exact Agentic Payments subject, projected across every ecosystem layer
narrative.customerProblem: Requirement tracking, semantic admission, delegated capability, planning, runtime execution, process evidence, evidence standing and human projection usually live in different systems that each hold a different copy of the subject, so nobody can see one deal end to end without hand-stitching tools that were never designed to agree.
narrative.desiredOutcome: One exact Agentic Payments subject, urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001, is visible through sJira, semantic law, SA2A, planning, runtime, OCEL, process conformance, evidence standing and human projection without changing subject identity, and no projection, analysis or UI surface gains DO authority.
narrative.semanticPath: docs/sjira/v26.10.1/ goal graph (RDF source) -> ggen-marketplace chicago-xaas-surface-pack deterministic render -> XaaS consumer projection -> AshSurface operator/Chicago/seller views

capabilities.label: XaaS runtime existence and execution state

scenarios.label: Bounded authorized purchase
scenarios.failureRecovery: Execution and ALIVE must still be established by the owning runtime and evidence courts; the positive path remains a prediction until a real exact-subject receipt exists.

scenarios.label: Amount exceeds delegated limit
scenarios.failureRecovery: Produce a typed refusal above the delegated limit with no protected DO; never silently split or re-price the request to fit the limit.

scenarios.label: Wrong principal
scenarios.failureRecovery: Refuse before any protected DO when the principal does not match the delegated authority subject.

scenarios.label: Expired delegation
scenarios.failureRecovery: Refuse as stale authority; an expired delegation is never refreshed implicitly.

scenarios.label: Provider unavailable before dispatch
scenarios.failureRecovery: Preserve the other admitted realizations, allow bounded replanning, and change no authority; pre-dispatch unavailability is a routing outcome, not a standing.

scenarios.label: Unknown after dispatch
scenarios.failureRecovery: Treat as UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH: reconcile the original consequence and never blind replay.

scenarios.label: Missing evidence cannot promote standing
scenarios.failureRecovery: Without the required exact-subject evidence and receipt the layer cannot promote to ALIVE, whatever consequence is claimed or inferred.

scenarios.label: Stale or mismatched subject
scenarios.failureRecovery: Refuse any receipt, plan or evidence object bound to a different or stale subject rather than generalizing it onto this one.

scenarios.label: Semantic policy drift invalidates stale plan
scenarios.failureRecovery: When relevant semantic or policy premises change, the stale plan loses applicability and the planner must re-enter bounded selection and replanning.

scenarios.label: Human projection cannot mint authority
scenarios.failureRecovery: Operator, buyer, seller and engineer views may differ in presentation, but none may grant DO or change the exact semantic subject or evidence.

authorityBoundaries: No AshSurface or seller projection owns business semantics.
No authored WorkOrder or Receipt belongs in this source graph.
No layer inherits ALIVE from a neighboring layer.
No real payment rail or financial settlement is implied by the Chicago demo subject.
No ticket, plan, model output, semantic-law result, process finding, generated artifact or UI projection gains DO authority.
